positions.stance: "NO MORE WAR. Bring all the troops home."
"Eliminate federal income tax and drastically cut spending."
"Attack inflation."
"No more sending tax dollars overseas, every dollar stays here."
"No more corporate bailouts."

H0KS03269.name: Steven A. Hohe
H0KS03269.bio: U.S. Air Force veteran of eleven years who has worked in telecommunications sales, metal building and equipment sales, and as an independent contractor courier.

positions.stance: Says "We’ve got to get Spartan on spending," downsizing government, ending corporate and foreign aid, and collecting on fraud.
Wants to break up D.C.'s "Iron Triangle" by kicking NGOs and lobbyists to the curb and restraining the power of appointed bureaucrats.
Supports abolishing the present income tax system for a flat tax not exceeding 10% on the employed, plus a staged tariff system on imports.
Supports giving each child a parent-controlled Educational Account, funded partly by flat-tax revenue, that follows the child.

H6KS04280.name: Drew Cranmer
H6KS04280.bio: Data engineer and small business founder.

positions.stance: "Bring the troops home. Stop nation-building. End unconditional foreign aid. Restore Article I."
Will oppose federal funding and mandates pushing surveillance infrastructure, such as license plate readers, into communities, and seek legal guardrails on government data collection.
Supports auditing the Federal Reserve and the "Penny Plan" principle of across-the-board annual spending cuts until the budget is balanced.
Will fight to return education, healthcare, land use, and law enforcement policy to the states and localities.
Pro-life; supports Dobbs and the Hyde Amendment, opposes federal legislation restoring Roe, and opposes the federal death penalty.

wiki:nik-sandman.name: Nik Sandman
wiki:nik-sandman.bio: Retired farmer of 26 years and former rural mail carrier.

positions.stance: Supports "true parity pricing that ensures farmers receive the cost of production plus a fair profit" instead of subsidies favoring corporate agriculture.
Supports Medicare For All covering prescriptions, dental, vision, and mental health: "No premiums. No deductibles. No bankruptcies."
"No warrantless searches. No civil asset forfeiture without conviction. No detention without due process."
Will "break up agricultural monopolies, enforce antitrust laws, and ensure local farmers can compete."
"Cut defense spending. Stop exporting war. Eliminate corporate welfare. Let working families keep more of what they earn."
Supports free markets, honest competition, lower taxes for working families, and responsible budgeting instead of growing debt.
Wants law enforcement focused on real violence, trafficking, and organized crime rather than "criminalizing peaceful Americans over victimless offenses."
Says crimes of child abuse, trafficking, and exploitation "should be aggressively prosecuted with serious consequences for predators and anyone who knowingly enables them."
Wants elected officials to answer to constituents first and explain their votes honestly, returning government closer to the people.
Believes many social services work better led by local organizations, and that government assistance should encourage pathways toward independence.

H6NE03206.name: Macey Budke
H6NE03206.bio: Behavioral health practice manager who grew up in ranching country.

positions.stance: Supports strengthening the rural healthcare workforce, protecting rural hospitals and clinics, and expanding behavioral and maternal healthcare access.
Supports policies to strengthen rural schools, improve teacher recruitment and retention, and expand career and technical education.
Supports policies that protect family farms and ranches, promote fair and competitive markets, and expand responsible trade opportunities.
Committed to transparent leadership through regular communication with constituents, direct answers, and visible presence in the district.
Supports a federal-state partnership ensuring rural communities get their fair share of investment in roads, bridges, broadband, water systems, and grid reliability.

H6NE03198.name: Mark Cohen
H6NE03198.bio: Former Air Force Judge Advocate and prosecutor with an advanced degree in agricultural law; karate instructor.

positions.stance: Supports strengthening and enforcing antitrust laws so large agricultural corporations cannot coerce or manipulate farmers and ranchers, including amending the Packers and Stockyards Act.
Opposes unilateral tariffs that harm Nebraska's agricultural export markets and supports expanding free and fair trade agreements.
Will protect and increase federal funding for Ogallala Aquifer research, monitoring, and conservation, and support cost-share for water-efficient irrigation.
Says fossil fuels are "a necessary bridge while we work toward cleaner energy" and leaders should invest in that transition.
Will fight to ensure BEAD and other federal broadband funds reach the most underserved rural areas, with enforceable buildout requirements.
"I WILL fight against endless spending on war and foreign countries!"
"I WILL fight for free healthcare for all!"
Will push for strong agriculture not reliant on government subsidies: "better to sell your crops than store them."
Will fight for an economy that encourages all able Americans to work, including raising the minimum wage.

H6ID01318.name: Sarah Zabel Peterson
H6ID01318.bio: Retired member of the U.S. Air Force.

positions.stance: Supports a bipartisan reform framework preserving Social Security along its principles of adequacy and equity for the next 75 years and beyond.
Supports tax reform asking more from the highest earners, plus regulatory and spending reform, to address the national debt.
Calls for targeted, sustained action on hospital and physician costs, prescription drug costs, and the insurance marketplace.
Says the federal government should remove obstacles raising housing costs, starting with ending broad tariffs and fixing the worker visa system.
"Drop the broad tariffs and commit to reasonable immigration reform."

H6ID02282.name: Emre Houser
H6ID02282.bio: Former U.S. Air Force member who served over 27 years and has owned an Idaho business for more than 15 years.

positions.stance: Pledges to "continue to stand up and fight" for constitutional rights he says are under direct attack.
"I will not allow our beloved public lands be sold to the highest bidder."
Says ICE raids, tariffs, and rising input costs are pushing smaller farms toward failure and their land toward mega corporations and private equity.
Supports automatic VA health care enrollment upon military discharge and properly funding the VA.
Supports letting Medicare and Medicaid negotiate drug prices as the VA does, citing estimated savings of $20-$40 billion per year.
Supports congressional term limits.
Supports banning congressional stock trading.
Supports ending forever wars and returning war powers to Congress.
Supports a lifetime lobbying ban for former Members of Congress.
Supports a minimum tax for billionaires.
"In Congress, I will vote “No” on any budget that will increase the national debt."
"Taxation? Theft."
"The Second Amendment? Shall not be infringed."
"Abortion? Not my axe to grind."
"Protect the environment by drilling, fracking, and mining essential minerals in the USA."

H0WV03193.name: Belinda Fox-Spencer
H0WV03193.bio: Has 22 years of experience in healthcare and 32 years in small business.

positions.stance: "I will uphold those principles and will not vote for any law that exceeds the authority granted by our Constitution."
Supports energy independence and farmers, opposes completely eliminating fossil fuels, and wants to eliminate excessive agricultural regulations.
Says families "deserve a Congress willing to show the same fiscal discipline" they practice at home.
"I strongly support the Second Amendment."
"I am Pro-Life."

H6HI01386.name: Nathan Berning
H6HI01386.bio: Co-founder and former leader of a national nonprofit helping pregnant women in crisis.

positions.stance: Will fight for federal housing and infrastructure partnerships, challenge policies that inflate everyday costs, and make tax policy work for working families.
"I oppose abortion"; says being pro-life means practical support for pregnancy, birth, housing, healthcare, childcare, and work.
Will fight to reduce needless federal barriers, improve access to capital, and support local agriculture, trades, technology, and responsible tourism.
Says clean water, healthy land, local food capacity, and responsible energy policy are essential, and federal decisions should be transparent and accountable.
"I will work with either party when it helps Hawaiʻi and stand against either party when it does not."
Lists "Universal Health Care" as a campaign priority.
Lists "Non-violence/Anti-war" as a campaign priority.
Lists "Higher Minimum Wage / Universal Basic Income (UBI)" as a campaign priority.
Lists "Food Production / Knowledge" as a campaign priority.
Lists "Homelessness - Housing First" as a campaign priority.
Proposes making the first $105,000 of every household's income free of federal income tax and a 23% minimum tax on corporations earning over $5 billion.
Supports returning zoning and land-use decisions to local communities and leveling the playing field for small, local builders.
Backs the PRIME Act and expanded small-scale processing, and opposes agribusiness subsidies that crowd out family farms.
Supports the Break Up Big Medicine Act and measures preserving Critical Access designations for rural hospitals.
Opposes new federal restrictions on law-abiding gun owners, backs national constitutional carry, and supports the Free Speech Protection Act.
Says closed-loop cooling "should be considered non-negotiable" and data centers must provide their own power so consumers avoid higher electricity rates.
Says current tariffs "have been excessive and are hurting our economy"; "Tariffs will not make America rich again."
"Above all else, I will fight hard to defend and protect rural healthcare in Montana."
Supports an "all of the above" approach including transferable mortgages, zoning changes for multi-family housing, first-time buyer down-payment assistance, and lower lumber tariffs.
Will work to protect Social Security and Medicare and deliver cost-of-living increases "without the need to raise the retirement age."

H6RI01161.name: Pedro DeSouza
H6RI01161.bio: Small business owner and data professional.

positions.stance: Opposes Wall Street buying single-family homes; supports cutting regulations and tax incentives for builders of lower-priced starter homes.
Says Congress "must bring down the basic costs of living," including gas, electricity, and heating costs.
Supports single-payer healthcare to "cut out that waste, cover every American, and put patients before profits."
"No more forever wars. No more blank checks."
Says "Congress must stop bankrupting America and start answering to the taxpayers who fund it."

H6AK01092.name: Bill Hill
H6AK01092.bio: Bristol Bay commercial fisherman who started a business in Naknek with his wife.

positions.stance: "I oppose short-sighted tariffs that are driving up prices"; will fight for new housing and energy projects in Alaska.
"In Congress, I’ll take on bycatch, and defend subsistence rights, and fairness for all user groups."
"I support taxing the 1% and closing tax loopholes."
"I support small business and middle class tax relief."
"I support a full ban on congressional stock trading."

H2AK00143.name: James C. "Jim" McDermott
H2AK00143.bio: U.S. Air Force veteran of 22.5 years who has run a small business and taught business at UAF.

positions.stance: Believes the Patriot Act and NDAA detention provisions "should be repealed or fundamentally reformed."
Supports regulating substances the way alcohol is regulated, with age verification, quality standards, and accountability for harm to others.
Supports a strong national defense but not open-ended military commitments made without Congressional authorization.
Supports zero-based federal budgeting and balanced budget requirements, and opposes continuing resolutions used to avoid hard choices.
"Tariffs are a tax. They are paid by American businesses and American consumers, not by the countries being targeted."

H4DC00100.name: Kymone Freeman
H4DC00100.bio: Playwright, activist, commentator, festival director, and co-founder of We Act Radio.

positions.stance: "No Representation, No Taxes"; calls for tax resistance and direct economic action to escalate the fight for DC statehood.
Wants budgets "prioritizing housing, healthcare, and education over policing and displacement."
Will tackle root causes by investing in economic opportunity and mental health resources and ending the school-to-prison pipeline.
"I support H.R. 79 – World Health Organization Withdrawal Act."
Opposes any currency, including a Central Bank Digital Currency, that gives government more oversight and control over how people spend money.
Says ownership and control of private property is an unalienable right and key to a successful free market.
"I am in favor of any bill that protects our family farms from inheritance taxes and onerous oversight by our government, including harmful treaties."
Says protecting the national electrical grid from foreign compromise, and upgrading it, must be a priority.

wiki:shawn-johnson.name: Shawn Johnson
wiki:shawn-johnson.bio: Former Army combat medic, sheriff's deputy, and Casper city councilman and vice mayor; practicing attorney in family law and criminal defense.

positions.stance: Believes "sending Americans into harm’s way should be a last resort."
Believes public officials must be careful with taxpayers' money and people should live "without unnecessary government interference."
